statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); shortdir=$(basename "$dir"); branch=$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); sep='\033[2m · \033[0m'; [ -n "$model" ] && printf '\033[2;36m%s\033[0m' "$model"; if [ -n "$effort" ]; then [ -n "$model" ] && printf '%b' "$sep"; ecolor='\033[2m'; case "$effort" in medium) ecolor='\033[2;32m';; high) ecolor='\033[2;33m';; xhigh) ecolor='\033[2;31m';; esac; printf '%b%s\033[0m' "$ecolor" "$effort"; fi; [ -n "$model" ] || [ -n "$effort" ] && printf '%b' "$sep"; printf '\033[2;34m%s\033[0m' "$shortdir"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf '%b\033[2;32m%s\033[0m' "$sep" "$branch"; if [ -n "$used" ]; then used_int=$(printf '%.0f' "$used"); color='\033[2m'; [ "$used_int" -ge 90 ] && color='\033[2;31m'; [ "$used_int" -ge 75 ] && [ "$used_int" -lt 90 ] && color='\033[2;33m'; filled=$((used_int / 10)); bar=''; for i in $(seq 1 10); do if [ $i -le $filled ]; then bar="${bar}▰"; else bar="${bar}▱"; fi; done; printf '%b%b%s %d%%\033[0m' "$sep" "$color" "$bar" "$used_int"; fi
